note: In place (no hips travel). speed: m/s of ground under a planted foot; dir: (x, z) of travel in the model's frame (+x left, +z forward); cycles: gait cycles (two steps each) in the clip; contact: each foot's stances as [start, end] shares of the whole clip (end < start wraps); leftStrike: when the left foot lands. Gun: the gun's butt (translation) and turn (rotation) in the spine_05 bone's frame (identity rest: the old Spine2 joint's), the gun's own frame being the glTF one (barrel along -z); rifle-hold-low / -high are the two holds, one frame each, with the pelvis square.
bones: Every clip keys the rotation of all 87 bones of this body (tripo-player-ue5: the UE5 names less jaw, eye_l and eye_r) as real glTF local rotations (rest included: a bone at rest holds its node rotation, which here is Tripo's T-pose bind, not the canonical pose), and the translation of root, pelvis, ik_foot_l, ik_foot_r, ik_hand_gun, ik_hand_l, ik_hand_r. Authored in canonical frames: local[b] = R[p]^-1 * canonicalLocal[b] * R[b] with R from tripo-player-ue5.frames.json. Exact mapping from the old skeleton: spine_02 / spine_04 / neck_02 and the metacarpals at their canonical locals. Twist bones keyed with this body's refit shares (frames file twistBones): local = canonicalLocal * twistY(share * a), canonicalLocal including the forearm's pre-turn; lowerarm_twist_02 / _01 = 0.834 / 0.879 of the hand's twist about the forearm, calf_twist_02 / _01 = 0.411 / 0.393 of the foot's about the shin, upperarm_twist_01 / _02 = -0.501 / -0.100 and thigh_twist_01 / _02 = -0.304 / -0.026 of the bone's own twist (swing-twist about +Y measured from the canonical local, unwrapped frame to frame; no clip winds a whole turn). IK bones: ik_foot_l/r = the feet's transforms in the root's space (ik_foot_root at rest), ik_hand_gun = hand_r (ik_hand_root at rest), ik_hand_l = hand_l in ik_hand_gun's frame, ik_hand_r = identity (ik_hand_gun's twin).
rootMotion: A clip whose notes carry `root` (per frame [x, z, yaw]: the transitions) keys the same track on the root bone: translation (x, 0, z) and rotation yaw about +Y, so root world = T(x, 0, z) * Ry(yaw) and everything else is relative to it (the pelvis translation is in the root's frame, as before). Every other clip keys root at rest (origin, identity): in place. A player that moves the character by notes `root` (as the game does) must hold the root bone at rest; one that plays the root bone (Unreal root motion) must not move the character too.
handling: Handling clips (swap-*, reload-*, shotgun-pump, *-aim-*) are upper-body actions over rifle-hold-low: their spine, neck, head and collarbones are played as a difference from that hold. Extra nodes under spine_05: GunIn (the gun coming off the back in a swap), PalmL / PalmR (palm middle and the hand's CANONICAL turn: the real hand_l / hand_r world rotation is it times the hand's rest world rotation), ElbowL / ElbowR (elbow). A gun track is its butt less that gun's carry shift. events: seconds; track: per frame, hold [left, right] (0 nothing, 1 Gun, 2 GunIn), curl [left, right] 0..1, and the loose parts where a clip moves them.
